view.detail: Segment facts in this filing are dimensioned on additional axes this project will not interpret: us-gaap:RestructuringPlanAxis, srt:ConsolidationItemsAxis, us-gaap:StatementOperatingActivitiesSegmentAxis, us-gaap:DisposalGroupClassificationAxis, srt:ProductOrServiceAxis. Treating a slice of a segment as the segment would double-count it.
